payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition.

claims.text: The NER model proposed is a hybrid multimodal network that takes both image and text as input for named entity recognition.
The approach incorporates visual contexts for named entity recognition tasks, marking it as the first of its kind.
The multimodal NER system combines visual information with textual information to improve performance over traditional text-only models.
The model uses a deep image network to augment textual information with relevant visual context.
